verdict.rationale: Aider's official scripting docs show a Python API (`Coder.create(main_model=..., fnames=...)` and `coder.run(...)`) that lets you embed and drive it from code, alongside the `--message` CLI mode for one-shot scripted runs. That is a first-party programmatic interface, but the evidence shows only a single-language snippet rather than a packaged, versioned SDK with reference documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK packages or multi-language SDKs, full API reference and stability guarantees, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the Python API.
